_about: SHELF of Persian, Tamil and Sanskrit classics in English before 1931 that no other shelf held: Arthur George and Edmond Warner's complete verse Shahnama of Firdausi (9 vols, Trübner's Oriental Series, 1905-25), G. U. Pope's Tamil classics from the Clarendon Press and W. H. Allen (the Kural 1886, the Naladiyar 1893, the Tiruvacagam 1900) and H. H. Wilson's Vishnu Purana (1840). Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 68); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check. 'pope' alone is left out as a common word.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
